Rolling Admission, Digital Business , Bachelor and Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration (3 yrs + 2 yrs)

kuvaus.en: In this bachelor's programme, you will gain expertise to navigate the future business landscape with digital fluency and strategic insight. Studying digital business is crucial because businesses increasingly rely on digital technologies to succeed, making these skills essential for growth in today's economy. Today's fast-changing environment and its evolving digital tools require professionals who understand the foundations of business and how to apply them in today’s digital world.

The scholarships are awarded by the end of September in every academic year. If student is awarded the scholarship, the paid fee is returned partially according to the scholarship percentages.

  • For the first academic year, there are no scholarships available
  • For the second academic year, 3 000 EUR scholarships will be granted for the students successfully completing the studies on the first academic year (min.of 60 ECTS credits)
  • For the third academic year,  3 000 EUR scholarships will be granted for the students successfully completing min.120 ECTS credits in the first and second academic years.

maksullisuusKuvaus.en: We offer an Early Bird discount of EUR 2 000 for the first academic year to those students who are required to pay a tuition fee. In order to receive this discount, you must confirm your place in the programme and pay the remaining tuition fee of EUR 10 000 within three weeks from the date of having received the Certificate of Admission.

suunniteltuKestoKuvaus.en:
Bachelor's Degree 3 years (180 ECTS credits) + Master's Degree 2 years (120 ECTS credits)*.

*After having successfully completed the Bachelor’s Degree, the student has an option to automatically continue his/her studies in a related Master’s programme without any further applying.

pohjakoulutusvaatimusTarkenne.en:
You are eligible to apply to LUT's English-language Bachelor's programmes through rolling admission if you have completed or will soon complete a degree outside of Finland by 31 August 2027 that gives you the eligibility for corresponding university studies in your home country.

You are not eligible to apply during this rolling admission in the following situations:

  • You have completed your upper secondary degree in Finland.

kuvaus.en: In this bachelor's programme, you will gain expertise to navigate the future business landscape with digital fluency and strategic insight. Studying digital business is crucial because businesses increasingly rely on digital technologies to succeed, making these skills essential for growth in today's economy. Today's fast-changing environment and its evolving digital tools require professionals who understand the foundations of business and how to apply them in today’s digital world.

osaamistavoitteet.en: The Bachelor's Programme in Digital Business will give you a wide range of skills and capabilities to successfully manage digital business in various contexts. During your studies in this programme, you will build your expertise and skills in designing and managing digitally evolving businesses – that is, implementing change in a customer-oriented manner using data and technology.

teksti.en: After graduating from the Bachelor's Programme in Digital Business, you will be qualified for various positions in industrial or public organisations. You can work as a digital analyst, social media manager, SEO specialist, product or business development manager, junior consultant, digital marketing specialist, digital transformation manager, or business intelligence or AI specialist.

During your studies, you will build your business expertise on a strong foundation of general studies, including the fundamentals of accounting, finance, and economics, the principles of management and business strategy, mathematics and statistics for economics, academic writing, and professional communication. In your specialisation studies, you will explore how digital platforms, artificial intelligence, and data are transforming business and enabling entirely new ways to create value. You will learn to understand the logic of the platform economy and digital ecosystems and develop innovative, scalable services in a global context. You will also gain basic skills in designing and managing digitally evolving businesses – that is, implementing change in a customer-oriented manner using data and technology.

The Bachelor’s Programme in Digital Business is a three-year programme. It leads to the degree of Bachelor of Science in Economics and Business Administration, B.Sc. (Econ. & Bus. Admin.), which is 180 ECTS credits. The programme includes general, intermediate specialisation studies, language and communication as well as a bachelor's thesis.

We strongly encourage you to include an international exchange period in your degree, taking advantage of LUT’s extensive partner network in choosing your exchange university. In addition, if you are an international student planning a career in Finland, we strongly recommend you include 18–20 ECTS credits of Finnish studies in your degree.

Most of the studies will be contact teaching on the Lahti campus. Some individual courses may also be partly or fully online. You will find the attendance requirements for each course in the course descriptions.
The bachelor's thesis, 10 ECTS credits, is a research project completed during the sixth semester of the degree programme. It is a part of the intermediate specialisation studies.

If you want to continue in the academic field, the bachelor's degree also gives you a direct route to further studies in the following master's programmes of LUT Business School:

  • Master’s Programme in International Business and Entrepreneurship, Lappeenranta campus.
  • Master’s Programme in International Marketing Management, Lappeenranta campus.
  • Master’s Programme in Supply Management, Lappeenranta campus.
  • A new English-language master's programme in the field of strategic management, Lahti campus. The programme will start in 2029.
  • Additionally, the software engineering minor subject enables you to continue your studies in the Master's Programme in Business Analytics.

LUT’s Master of Science in Economics and Business Administration degree prepares students also for post graduate studies (Doctor of Science in Economics and Business Administration). For more information, visit LUT Doctoral School.
